issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted 2026-08-12) specifies R025 but no open bead tracks it, and the ADR's field measurement shows inverted verification gates are a persistent authoring error (21 edges in one workspace, 24 plus 7 cycles in another) that silently strands work. Add a third dependency kind, `verifies`, alongside `blocks`, so authors can declare the check relationship explicitly, while §3.4's insert-time two-kind set and cycle rejection stay unchanged. Extend `bead doctor` to diagnose inversion structurally from that declaration — a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` the blocked bead — reported under the dependency scope, advisory only: never reject the edge at insert time, never infer the relationship from issue titles. Cover the new edge kind in checkpoint serialization/round-trip, list/show projection, conformance tests, and concurrency tests for edge insertion.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement R025: verifies dependency kind with advisory inverted-gate diagnosis (ADR-001)

issue.description:
Guard automatic checkpoint publication and sync flush-only while durable recovery quarantine is active, following research/specs/secret-write-boundary-v1.md section 4.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every checkpoint publisher checks quarantine under the publication lock and refuses with a redacted secret_quarantined result without advancing generation or changing checkpoint files. Restart and no-auto-flush settings do not clear quarantine.
- Audited redaction rechecks live state and every retained generation; quarantine clears only when no unacknowledged blocking finding remains.
- Synthetic tests cover automatic publication, flush-only, repeat/restart behavior, and the redaction remedy without emitting matched bytes.
issue.notes: Fixed the recovery/publication race: native forensic import, verified restore, and legacy import now take the destination checkpoint publication lock before activation; reconcile reuses its existing lock via a holding entry point.
